name: Color-Based 1D Transfer Function for Photographic Volumes
definition: A method to create an interactive 1D opacity transfer function for photographic volumes by mapping 3D RGB colors to a 1D axis of 256 representative colors, allowing users to classify voxels based on color intuition rather than abstract scalar values.
summary: This method creates an interactive 1D opacity transfer function for photographic volumes by mapping 3D RGB colors to a 1D axis, ensuring global color consistency unlike local decolorization methods.
